scope: Freeze the transitional TypeScript-owned SQLite DB compatibility mode, document the future pure-Go DB target, and make Go unsupported/degraded behavior discoverable before users trigger side effects.

futureGoResponsibilities: schema drift fixtures and release gates
principles.goBehavior: read-only canonical schema and migration compatibility checks while SQLite remains in the transition stage; no business schema creation, ALTER, index creation, FTS rebuild, or main DB repair in this mode

fallbackShapeScope: Route-level fallback/error payloads should expose reason/error/message; health capability metadata must at minimum expose reason when fallback or unsupported is advertised.
